messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — after running the AWQ INT8 sensitivity sweep on redwood-3b-v1 we see a noticeable accuracy delta on a few tasks, plus some formatting hallucinations.
maria: Numbers? which tasks?
alex: Short summary: LegalQA EM down ~12 pts (86.4 -> 74.3), Codegen BLEU down 3.6 (42.1 -> 38.5), JSON-output formatting failures up from 0.7% -> 6.2%. Repro command I used:
```bash
python ./tools/eval_suite.py --model redwood-3b-v1 --quant awq --bits 8 --profile tasks:legal_qa,codegen,json_fmt --batch 1 --seed 42 --save-outputs out/awq-run1.json
```
alex: Observed the formatting fail mode: model returns concatenated paragraph instead of structured JSON for prompts that used to produce strict JSON. Example (expected vs awq-int8):
```
# expected
{"title": "Contract Termination", "clauses": ["..."]}
# awq-int8 output
The contract says you can end it early. Clause one says...
```
sam: Hmm. Could be quantization-induced logit scaling + softmax temp shift for structural tokens. Did you try GPTQ or FP8 for comparison?
alex: Ran quick GPTQ-ptq and FP8 runs: GPTQ keeps LegalQA EM at 85.9 (almost baseline). FP8 also close to baseline (86.1). So issue seems specific to AWQ 8-bit config we used.
taylor: Any batch-size dependency? KV-cache/batching bug can cause token misalignment that looks like hallucination/formatting drift.
alex: Good call — I re-ran AWQ with batch=8 and saw more severe formatting collapse (JSON fails jumped to 11%). batch=1 is better but still bad.
jing: I'll start by dumping per-step logits for a small set of failing prompts and compare to fp32. Use topk cosine between logit vectors, and also token-id alignment check for the first 64 tokens. I have a small script for this.
maria: Also check the quant config: scale clipping, group-size, outlier-handling. AWQ has a couple knobs that can bias high-prob tokens. Which branch/commit?
alex: Branch is quant/awq-sweep, commit a3f9b2d. Config snippet I used: 
```json
{"block_size": 128, "group_size": 256, "clip_threshold": 2.5, "outlier_method": "abs-max"}
```
maria: Try lowering clip_threshold to 1.5 and re-run a small set. If the structural tokens get suppressed by clipping that's a sign.
sam: Also test with deterministic attention kernel on CPU for a tiny sequence to check if runtime kernels introduce nondeterminism.
taylor: Filing a short triage checklist: 1) logits diff for 20 failing prompts (jing) 2) config sweep: clip_threshold & group_size (maria) 3) cross-quant compare GPTQ/FP8/AWQ same seed (alex) 4) batch-size sweep for seq-len > 128 (sam) 5) reproduce in private deploy (taylor)
jing: I'll own 1 and will post diffs to #eng-ml in a separate thread. Plan to push a small artifact: out/logit-diffs-1778502468.tar.gz
ci-bot: Scheduled job started: runners/eval-1778502468 on aws-us-west2 (logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/1778502468) :rocket:
alex: Thanks all — let's try to converge by EOD. If AWQ can't be massaged to preserve structure we'll mark it as "not-ready" for redwood-3b-v1 and keep GPTQ/FP8 as candidates for deploy profiles. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
